dialogue.content: シナモンさん今日はよろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Cinnamon, thank you for coming today.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Thank you for having me.

dialogue.content: お時間になりましたら始めさせていただきますね。
dialogue.English: It looks like it's time, so shall we begin?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: こんばんは。相談員です。差し支えなければ、年齢と性別をおしえていただけますか
dialogue.English: Good evening. I'm your counselor. If you don't mind, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 23才、男性です
dialogue.English: I'm 23 years old and male.

dialogue.content: 教えてくださりありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that with me.

dialogue.content: 今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 仕事がつらいです
dialogue.English: My job is really tough.

dialogue.content: やめたくてたまりません
dialogue.English: I desperately want to quit.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。そうお感じなんですね
dialogue.English: I see. So that's how you're feeling.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: もう少し詳しくお話お聴きしても良いでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Could you tell me a little more about it?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お仕事をやめたくなったのは、どんなことがあったのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What has been happening at work that makes you want to quit?

dialogue.content: 忙しすぎるし難しいことばかりでつらいです
dialogue.English: It's too busy, and everything is so difficult. It's painful.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。そんなふうに思うと、しんどくなってしまいますね・・
dialogue.English: I see. Feeling that way must be exhausting.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ちなみに、どのようなお仕事をされていますか？
dialogue.English: By the way, what kind of work do you do?

dialogue.content: 金融関係です
dialogue.English: I work in finance.

dialogue.content: 教えてくださりありがとうございます。具体的にはどのような忙しさなのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing. In what ways is it busy, specifically?

dialogue.content: 終電がなくなってタクシーで帰る日もあります
dialogue.English: There are days I miss the last train and have to take a taxi home.

dialogue.content: ええ？？そんなにも遅い時間まで・・
dialogue.English: Oh my goodness, that late into the night...

dialogue.content: 今時珍しいですよね
dialogue.English: It's rare these days, isn't it?

dialogue.content: 友達は誰もそんなに忙しいヤツはいません
dialogue.English: None of my friends are that busy.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。とても疲れてしまいますよね・・食事はきちんと食べていますか？
dialogue.English: I see. That must be incredibly tiring... Are you managing to eat properly?

dialogue.content: 昼は食べ忘れてる時もあります
dialogue.English: Sometimes I forget to eat lunch.

dialogue.content: 夕方食べたり夜中に食べたり
dialogue.English: I end up eating in the evening or late at night.

dialogue.content: めちゃくちゃです
dialogue.English: It's a complete mess.

dialogue.content: そんな不規則になっているのですねあなたの体が心配になってきます。
dialogue.English: It's become that irregular. I'm getting worried about your health.

dialogue.content: 死にたくなります
dialogue.English: It makes me want to die.

dialogue.content: そんなふうに思ってしまうほど・・お辛くなってしまいますね・・
dialogue.English: You must be in so much pain to be feeling that way.

dialogue.content: つらいです
dialogue.English: It's painful.

dialogue.content: いつ頃からなんでしょう？忙しくなったのは。
dialogue.English: About how long has it been this busy?

dialogue.content: 入ってすぐです
dialogue.English: Right after I joined.

dialogue.content: 容赦ないです
dialogue.English: It's relentless.

dialogue.content: 入ってというと？もう何年も前から、今のような生活なんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: When you say 'right after you joined'... does that mean you've been living like this for years?

dialogue.content: 大学卒業後入省してすぐです
dialogue.English: It started right after I joined the ministry, just after graduating from university.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。そんな前から・・本当に良く耐えてお仕事されてきたのですね・・
dialogue.English: I see. All the way back since then... You've really endured and worked so hard.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ちなみに、あなたの周りのかた、同僚などの方々もそんなに忙しく働いてるのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: By the way, are the people around you, like your colleagues, also working such long hours?

dialogue.content: 所属してる部の人はみんなそんな感じです
dialogue.English: Everyone in my department is like that.

dialogue.content: 忙しい所に配属されたみたいです
dialogue.English: It seems I was assigned to a busy department.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。それは、大変でしたね
dialogue.English: I see. That must have been really tough.

dialogue.content: 仕事ができる人でも処理しきれないほどの仕事量です
dialogue.English: The workload is so heavy that even a very capable person couldn't handle it all.

dialogue.content: そんなにも多い仕事量・・肉体的にも精神的もまいってしまうのでは、と心配になってしまいます
dialogue.English: Such a heavy workload... I worry it must be taking a toll on you, both physically and mentally.

dialogue.content: はい、でも自分だけではないので仕方ないです
dialogue.English: Yes, but I'm not the only one, so I guess it can't be helped.

dialogue.content: そう思われているんですねでも、今のままでは身体も心も悲鳴をあげそうな感じがします夜は良く眠れてしますか？
dialogue.English: That's how you see it. But I'm concerned that if things continue this way, your body and mind are going to start screaming for help. Are you able to sleep well at night?

dialogue.content: あんまり眠れません
dialogue.English: I can't really sleep well.

dialogue.content: 睡眠時間も取れないので。
dialogue.English: I just can't get enough hours of sleep.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。と、いいますと、朝は何時に家を出るのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. So, what time do you leave home in the morning?

dialogue.content: 朝は9時に家を出ます。
dialogue.English: I leave home at 9 a.m.

dialogue.content: 睡眠時間もないなんて、辛すぎますね・・
dialogue.English: Not having enough time to sleep... that must be incredibly hard.

dialogue.content: 月に2、3回は帰宅が3時とかです
dialogue.English: Two or three times a month, I get home around 3 a.m.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。それは、きついですね
dialogue.English: I see. That's grueling.

dialogue.content: もっと仕事ができればいいんですけどね
dialogue.English: I wish I were better at my job.

dialogue.content: ご自分のことをそんな感じに思っているのですね仕事が終わらなくて、日付が変わるまでかかってしまうということなんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: So that's how you feel about yourself? That you can't finish your work and it takes you until after midnight?

dialogue.content: そうです
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: お仕事がもっとできるようになれば、遅くまでは働かなくても済むのに・・と
dialogue.English: So you feel that if you were better at your job, you wouldn't have to work so late...

dialogue.content: 少なくとも今より早く帰れると思います
dialogue.English: I think I could at least go home earlier than I do now.

dialogue.content: 仕事ができるようになるには、どうしたらいいか悩んでおられる感じでしょうか
dialogue.English: It sounds like you’re struggling with how to become better at your job.

dialogue.content: 仕事のやり方は少しずつ良くなってると思ってます
dialogue.English: I think the way I do my work is gradually improving.

dialogue.content: でも平日に自由な時間がないのがストレスです
dialogue.English: But having no free time on weekdays is stressful.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね自由な時間というと？お休みが欲しいということなんでしょうか
dialogue.English: I see. When you say "free time," do you mean you want more days off?

dialogue.content: 土日は休みですが、あっという間に終わってしまうし
dialogue.English: I have weekends off, but they're over in a flash.

dialogue.content: やりたいことがあるのにやれないです
dialogue.English: There are things I want to do, but I can't.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね平日にもしたいことがあるんですね
dialogue.English: I see. So you have things you want to do on weekdays, too.

dialogue.content: それができないと、余計に嫌になってしまいますよね・・
dialogue.English: Not being able to do that must make it even more frustrating.

dialogue.content: ちなみに、あなたのしたいことってどんなことなんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: By the way, what are the things you'd like to do?

dialogue.content: 勉強です
dialogue.English: Studying.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。それはすごいですね。勉強っていうと、何か資格のため？どんなことを目指してるんでしょう？
dialogue.English: I see. That's impressive. When you say studying, is it for a qualification of some kind? What are you aiming for?

dialogue.content: 仕事で必要な知識を入れないといけないし、留学もしたいので。
dialogue.English: I need to acquire the knowledge necessary for my job, and I also want to study abroad.

dialogue.content: なるほど・・ですね。お仕事も努力されているのですね。そして留学も考えておられるんですね。
dialogue.English: I see... So you're putting a lot of effort into your work, and you're also thinking about studying abroad.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 勉強が全然はかどらないです
dialogue.English: My studying isn't progressing at all.

dialogue.content: 確かに、今の状況ではお時間がとても取れずに、この先どうしたらいいか考えてしまいますよね
dialogue.English: I can certainly see how in your current situation, it's very hard to find the time, and it would make you wonder what to do from here.

dialogue.content: 留学は無理ですね
dialogue.English: Studying abroad seems impossible.

dialogue.content: 転職とかも視野にいれて悩んでおられる感じなんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Are you perhaps considering something like changing jobs as well?

dialogue.content: 今すぐに転職はしません
dialogue.English: I'm not going to change jobs right now.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。今の状況では、留学もあきらめてしまうのも無理はないと思います。
dialogue.English: I understand. In your current situation, it's natural to feel like you have to give up on studying abroad.

dialogue.content: 今までのお話を伺って、感じたのですが、例えば、違う部署などに異動の希望とかは出せないのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Based on what you've shared with me, I was wondering—for example, is it possible to request a transfer to a different department?

dialogue.content: 今の部署は今年度までです
dialogue.English: I'm in my current department only until the end of this fiscal year.

dialogue.content: ローテーションなので。
dialogue.English: Because it's a rotation system.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね来年度はあまり忙しくない部署にいけそうな感じですか？
dialogue.English: I see. Does it seem likely you'll be moved to a less busy department next fiscal year?

dialogue.content: どうでしょうか…
dialogue.English: I'm not sure...

dialogue.content: 今の所は1番忙しいとも言われてるので
dialogue.English: My current department is said to be the busiest, so...

dialogue.content: そうなるといいでふ
dialogue.English: I hope so.

dialogue.content: そうなるといいです
dialogue.English: I hope so.

dialogue.content: 確かに異動してみないと、わからないですよねでも今よりはお時間が取れそうな感じだといいですよね
dialogue.English: That's true, you won't know for sure until you're actually transferred. But it would be great if it meant you'd have more free time than you do now.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: あなたは、休日も仕事のスキルアップをはかって勉強されたり、留学の為の勉強もされていて、なかなかできることではないと思います。
dialogue.English: The fact that you're using your days off to study to improve your work skills and also to prepare for studying abroad... I don't think that's something many people could do.

dialogue.content: そうですかね…
dialogue.English: Do you really think so...?

dialogue.content: 今のようなとてもお忙しい状況なのに、本当によくやっておられると思いました。
dialogue.English: Despite being in such an incredibly busy situation, I think you are doing remarkably well.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: ご自分のことを褒めてあげてくださいね
dialogue.English: Please give yourself some credit.

dialogue.content: 並大抵のことではないですよ
dialogue.English: It's no small feat.

dialogue.content: 頑張ってるんですけどね
dialogue.English: I am trying my best, though.

dialogue.content: 今まで一番忙しいと言われている部署でも、耐えてこられて、
dialogue.English: You've managed to endure this long in what's said to be the busiest department,

dialogue.content: 自信をもってもいいと思います
dialogue.English: and I think you can be confident in yourself for that.

dialogue.content: 留学も是非とも、実現してほしいです
dialogue.English: I truly hope you can make your dream of studying abroad a reality.

dialogue.content: 今すぐはできないけど、なんとかできたらいいです
dialogue.English: I can't do it right now, but I hope I can make it happen somehow.

dialogue.content: はい。その気持ちがとても大事かと思います
dialogue.English: Yes. I think that feeling is very important.

dialogue.content: そうですか
dialogue.English: Is that so?

dialogue.content: あなたの夢を応援していますね
dialogue.English: I'm rooting for your dreams.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 今すぐはできないけど、いつかきっと、という気持ちを忘れないで、
dialogue.English: That feeling of, 'I can't do it right now, but someday for sure...' please don't forget it.

dialogue.content: いって欲しいと思います
dialogue.English: I hope you'll hold onto that feeling and keep moving forward.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I will.

dialogue.content: 今のあなたの頑張りはきっと、いつの日か実を結ぶ時がくるはすです
dialogue.English: Your hard work right now will surely bear fruit one day.

dialogue.content: そう信じて、
dialogue.English: Believe in that,

dialogue.content: あなたなら、きっと乗り越えられると思いますよ
dialogue.English: and I believe you can overcome this.

dialogue.content: そうだといいと思います
dialogue.English: I hope you're right.

dialogue.content: あとできたら、時には栄養のある美味しいものを食べたりして、頑張っている自分にご褒美をあげてくださいね
dialogue.English: Also, if you can, please treat yourself to something delicious and nutritious sometimes as a reward for all your hard work.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今日のご相談は大丈夫そうでしょうか？また、ぜひ辛い時には気持ちを吐き出しにきてくださいね。
dialogue.English: Do you feel we've covered everything for today? Please feel free to come back and talk anytime you're having a hard time.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: ぜひ、お持ちしていますね
dialogue.English: I’ll be here for you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 今日はお越しいただきありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much for coming today.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.content: では終了にさせていただきますね。こちらこそ、ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Then I'll end the session here. Thank you as well.

dialogue.content: お疲れ様でした！
dialogue.English: Thank you for your time.

dialogue.content: （シナモンさん、今日はありがとうございました。）
dialogue.English: (Cinnamon, thank you for today.)

dialogue.content: こちらこそありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you, too.

dialogue.content: （終了ボタン押させていただきますね）
dialogue.English: (I'll press the 'End' button now.)

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.
